collection.description: A villager grows attached to a territorial little creature that guards a favorite spot.

intro.name: The setup
intro.text: A villager becomes attached to a territorial bird or crab that defends a favorite spot.

a.name: Outcome A
a.text: They admire it from a distance and protect its habitat.

b.name: Outcome B
b.text: The creature begins recognizing the villager and returns often.

c.name: Outcome C
c.text: An attempt to keep it causes distress; the villager releases it.
